description: Split 1 to 10 songs into stems on the connected StemConsole account, using its own plan and allowance, the same as splitting on the website. Give each song as a public audio URL (a direct file link; Dropbox and Google Drive share links work). One song starts at once and returns its split; 2 to 10 are queued as a batch that runs two at a time. Then poll get_split or get_batch until status is done. model: vocals = Vocal Remover (vocals, instrumental), fast = Basic Split (vocals, drums, bass, other), full = Full Separation (adds guitar and piano; Pro or a credit).

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, AAC or WMA, up to 200 MB).

name.description: Song name for the library. Defaults to the file name.

name: split_songs
title: Split songs into stems
